hook: A hydrogel patch makes gastric leaks visible on ultrasound in rabbits for up to 7 days.
summary: An implantable patch made entirely of hydrogel contains rings of air cells that scatter ultrasound strongly, so a gastric leak changes its image signature. It was tested in live rabbits for up to 7 days after implantation. Only a small animal model was used, so human performance is untested.
title: A fully hydrogel implantable patch for in situ ultrasonic monitoring of gastric leakage.
